name: Polar
short_desc: External: connect Polar so Health and your agent get Nightly Recharge, sleep, activity and training (read-only). Needs your own free Polar AccessLink API client.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your Polar with a guided setup inside the app. Needs your own developer credentials: a free Polar AccessLink API client you create on admin.polaraccesslink.com with your Polar Flow account (the app shows every value to copy). The app keeps a private synced copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows readiness from Nightly Recharge, sleep, activity and training. Keys and sign-in stay in the app.
